_note: Demo SOP written by the team from general first-aid and disaster guidance. Not an official procedure.

injured.text: Confirm the location and the number of injured people with the reporter.
Send the nearest medical team with a stretcher and first-aid kit.
Ask the group to keep the injured person warm and still.
Arrange evacuation to the nearest medical post if walking is not possible.
Inform the base hospital to prepare for arrival.

medical.text: Ask about breathing, consciousness and altitude symptoms.
Send the nearest medical team with oxygen.
Advise the person to stop climbing and rest.
Plan descent if altitude sickness is suspected.

lost.text: Check the last known position and the offline path from queued pings.
Ask the tourist to stay where they are.
Send a search team from the nearest checkpoint along the last known path.
Send a safety check to nearby tourists for sightings.

stuck.text: Confirm whether the path ahead and behind is blocked.
Publish a closed zone for the blocked section.
Guide the group to the nearest shelter if safe.
Arrange food, water and warm clothing if the wait is long.

unsafe.text: Ask whether the person is in immediate danger.
Alert the nearest police post with the location.
Ask the tourist to move to a crowded, lit place if possible.

crowd.text: Stop new entries into the crowded section.
Open the alternate path and announce it.
Station staff at narrow points to slow the flow.

unknown.text: Call back the reporter to understand the situation.
Send the nearest patrol to check the location.
